title: Soil deepened another 2.5x, as asked (rolling, seed 1)
question: Is this the depth you wanted, or should it go further still? Sky is unchanged from last time, per your note.
context_md:
Follow-up to your *"increase the soil another 2-3x, keep the sky the same"*. Same world, same seed, same strip as the last card.

- **A** is what you already saw and approved (`soil_depth` 42)
- **B** is 2.5x that — the middle of the range you gave (`soil_depth` 105)

Sky is identical in both at `sky_rows` 190; nothing about it changed.

**What the numbers say**, since depth is mostly below the surface and the picture only shows the cross-section: realised soil went p50 25 -> 62 cells, p90 48 -> 120, max 68 -> 166.

**One thing this turned up.** Two separate 'how far may I dig through loose cover' bounds (residuals and boulders) were both set at 80 cells against a world whose deepest cover used to be 43. At this depth ordinary ground is deeper than that, so the bounds had quietly started refusing real rock formations — seed 1 was losing 22% of its residual stone. Both re-derived to 300, and that stone is back. Nothing about it is visible in this pair; it is why the tors on the left are there at all.

If you want it deeper still, say so and I will take it to 3x or past it — nothing in the engine now objects.
